# Maiko Trindade

> Senior Android Engineer and Software Developer with 14+ years in software development and 10+ in Android. This site covers Android development, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, AI agents, blockchain/Solidity, and software engineering.

Author: Maiko Trindade

## Blog — AI & Agents

- [Why Coding Agents Struggle With Mobile, and the Harness That Fixes It](https://maikotrindade.com/ai-agents/engineering/2026/11/02/why-coding-agents-struggle-mobile-harness.html): Why mobile feedback loops are hard on coding agents, what Android agent research shows, and a seven-step harness built on narrow tools, device tests, and honest failure reporting.
- [Jev: A Decision Model for the Boring, Important Parts of Your Pipeline](https://maikotrindade.com/ai-agents/llm/2026/10/15/jev-typesafe-decision-model-guide.html): What TypeSafe AI's type-safe Jev decision model is, what changed in Jev 1.14, and how to pair it with an LLM for cheap classification.
- [An Introduction to Edge Computing and Edge AI](https://maikotrindade.com/ai/edge-computing/2026/09/14/introduction-edge-computing-edge-ai.html): What edge computing and Edge AI are, the newest small on-device models (Gemma 4, SmolLM3, Phi-4-mini), Edge AI in AgTech, and research on where it goes next.
- [AI Beyond Tech: Slower Data Centers, Smarter Human Uses](https://maikotrindade.com/ai/sustainability/2026/08/14/ai-beyond-tech-farms-data-center-race.html): How LLMs help smallholder farmers, builders and sustainability teams, what agricultural-advice research shows, why small efficient models beat the data center race, and what blockchain's energy shift teaches AI.
- [Loop Engineering in Practice: What No Middleman Taught Me About Verifying AI-Written Code](https://maikotrindade.com/ai-agents/engineering/2026/07/24/loop-engineering-verifying-ai-written-code-no-middleman.html): How the No Middleman loop verifies AI-written React Native code with a Detox oracle, an adversarial checker, and hard invariants instead of trusting the diff.
- [Loop Engineering: Designing the Control Loop Behind Autonomous Agents](https://maikotrindade.com/ai-agents/engineering/2026/07/02/loop-engineering-autonomous-agents.html): Practical guide to designing the plan, act, observe loop behind autonomous agents, covering termination conditions, context budgets, and failure handling.
- [How to Actually Test Autonomous AI Agents](https://maikotrindade.com/ai-agents/testing/2026/05/20/testing-autonomous-ai-agents.html): A practical opinion on testing autonomous AI agents using trajectory evaluation, observability, real-workflow benchmarks, and production-grade reliability practices.
- [Awesome React Native Skills: Claude Skills for Modern Mobile Dev](https://maikotrindade.com/ai/agents/claude/react-native/2026/05/12/awesome-react-native-skills.html): Curated collection of Claude Skills covering core, ecosystem, Expo, performance, and testing for production React Native apps.
- [Building Reusable Skills for Claude: A Complete Guide](https://maikotrindade.com/ai/agents/claude/anthropic/2026/03/27/building-reusable-skills-for-claude.html): How to build, configure, and distribute reusable markdown-based Skills for Claude using progressive disclosure, SKILL.md frontmatter, and MCP integration.
- [Capitol Trades Tracker: AI-Powered Investment Intelligence](https://maikotrindade.com/artificial-intelligence/2026/01/18/introducing-capitol-trades-tracker.html): Agentic AI Android app tracking U.S. congressional stock trades using Koog, LLMs, and OpenRouter.
- [Understanding AI Agents: Concepts, Architecture, and Tools](https://maikotrindade.com/ai/agents/automation/agentic%20systems/llm/2025/10/02/understanding-ai-agents-concepts-architecture-tools.html): Comprehensive overview of AI agent architecture, reasoning, planning, and tools like LangChain, CrewAI, and Koog.
- [Building an Agentic AI Mobile Tester with Koog and Kotlin](https://maikotrindade.com/ai/kotlin/android/development/agents/2025/08/19/building-agentic-ai-mobile-tester-koog-kotlin.html): What JetBrains' Koog agent framework is, and how I used it with Ktor and ADB tools to build an LLM-driven Android end-to-end tester.
- [Exploring Android Studio's Gemini Journeys](https://maikotrindade.com/android/ai/testing/2025/05/20/exploring-android-studio-gemini-journeys-ai-testing.html): AI-powered E2E test generation in Android Studio using Gemini natural language prompts.

## Blog — Android & Jetpack Compose

- [Jetpack Compose and React Native: More Similar Than You Think](https://maikotrindade.com/android/react-native/2026/04/25/jetpack-compose-react-native-similarities.html): How Jetpack Compose concepts — state, composables, effects, navigation — map directly to React Native for Android developers.
- [AGSL: A Quick Introduction to Android Graphics Shading Language](https://maikotrindade.com/android/graphics/2025/11/28/introduction-to-android-shading-language.html): GPU shaders in Android using AGSL for visual effects in Compose.
- [Untangling State and Side Effects in Jetpack Compose](https://maikotrindade.com/android/compose/development/2025/03/08/untangling-state-android-app-management.html): Where Compose state should live (remember, hoisting, state holders, ViewModel with StateFlow) and how LaunchedEffect, DisposableEffect and SideEffect run.
- [A Guide to Accessibility in Android Apps with Jetpack Compose](https://maikotrindade.com/2024/12/03/a-guide-to-accessibiliy-in-android-apps-jetpack-compose.html): TalkBack, Switch Access and other Android accessibility services, Compose semantics (content descriptions, click labels, state, merging, headings), touch targets, contrast and accessibility testing.
- [Kotlin Multiplatform for Android and iOS: A Practical Introduction](https://maikotrindade.com/2024/09/04/build-better-apps-with-kotlin-multiplatform.html): How KMP projects are structured, expect/actual, multiplatform libraries, calling Kotlin from Swift, Compose Multiplatform and how KMP compares with React Native and Flutter.
- [Migrating from XML Views to Jetpack Compose: A Practical Guide](https://maikotrindade.com/2023/02/12/migration-from-jetpack-compose.html): Why and in what order to migrate, ComposeView and AndroidView interop, theming, state, performance and testing pitfalls.
- [Kotlin Coroutines on Android: A Practical Guide](https://maikotrindade.com/2020/02/20/coroutines-android-simplify-code.html): Suspend functions, scopes, dispatchers, structured concurrency, cancellation, exception handling, Flow and testing with runTest.
- [Android WorkManager: A Practical Guide to Background Work](https://maikotrindade.com/2019/02/03/introduction-android-work-manager.html): CoroutineWorker, constraints, unique and periodic work, chaining, expedited work, observing progress and testing workers.

## Blog — Blockchain & Solidity

- [Solidity Fundamentals: A Practical Guide for 0.8.x](https://maikotrindade.com/blockchain/solidity/2026/11/17/solidity-fundamentals-guide.html): Solidity 0.8.x fundamentals in one guide: contract anatomy, types, data locations, mappings, events and custom errors, gas and EIP-1559 fees, calls vs transactions, global variables and inheritance.
- [Ethereum Token Standards Explained: ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 and ERC-777](https://maikotrindade.com/blockchain/solidity/2026/11/17/ethereum-token-standards-erc20-erc721-erc1155.html): Fungible vs non-fungible tokens, how ERC-20, ERC-721 and ERC-1155 work, why ERC-777 is discouraged, and which standard to use.
- [Integrate an Android App with an ERC-20 Token in Kotlin](https://maikotrindade.com/2023/08/02/integrate-android-app-with-erc20-token.html): Reading ERC-20 balances with JSON-RPC eth_call, ABI selectors, decimals, protecting RPC keys and signing writes through a wallet.
- [Nomad Token – Chainlink Hackathon](https://maikotrindade.com/2023/06/28/nomad-token-chainlink-hackathon.html): Building a full blockchain ecosystem for a Chainlink hackathon.
- [Blockchain Consensus Mechanisms Explained: PoW, PoS, BFT and More](https://maikotrindade.com/2022/03/12/consensus-types.html): Proof of Work, Ethereum's Proof of Stake, BFT protocols, Delegated PoS, Proof of Authority and Stellar's federated agreement, with finality and trade-offs.
